displayName: VB6 form + COM interop → .NET 10 / WinForms + xUnit
description: Reference VB6→.NET-10 scaffold for thick-client VB6 line-of-business apps that stay thick-client. A representative form (frmOrderEntry.frm) becomes a WinForms class with typed event handlers ('btn.Click += BtnSubmit_Click'); DAO/ADO recordset use becomes an EF Core 10 repository; late-bound 'CreateObject("Excel.Application")' becomes a managed ClosedXML invoice exporter; 'On Error Goto' becomes typed try/catch with explicit error-label semantics. Produces a buildable, dotnet-test-runnable package targeting net10.0-windows. Every public surface carries a [SpecClaim(...)] attribute tying it back to the signed spec. Per ADR-036 this is the closest paradigm match to original VB6 — picked during Discovery for codebases that retain a desktop deployment.

matches.fallback: Used whenever the spec's target_archetype_hint is 'WinForms', regardless of routine name. Engineering teams can supplement this archetype with corpus-specific variants during Discovery.
